description.value:
You have a voracious desire to understand how your spellcraft could apply to all traditions, to truly unify your creative vision. You select a fourth Artifex’s motif that has a favored tradition that you do not have. You gain this motif’s favored tradition and learn its foundation Visionary spell. You can use any of your tradition spells with your motif spell slots, and can choose which of the four traditions your spells belong to when you cast them. You also learn and can prepare that motif’s additional 10th rank spell into your 10th rank spell slot.

You gain your choice of one skill feat that requires the Arcana, Religion, Nature or Occult skills, using your proficiency with your visionary skill for the purpose of prerequisites. If this skill feat uses that skill for a check, you can use your visionary skill proficiency in place of it instead.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.r9cs1R4mdnTVbefD]{Avant-Garde} feat, you can reselect all of the spells you selected from that feat when you gain Omnitraditional Study. You can select spells of any motif’s tradition that you have, including your initial motif’s tradition.
